_comment: Preferred setup is pairing: run WindowsPrintAgent.exe --PairingCode=XXXX-XXXX once. The device token is then stored encrypted outside this file. Only fill in AgentApiKey below if you are using the legacy shared-key setup.
_PrintOkApiUrl: Optional. The agent already defaults to the PrintOk cloud, so this only needs setting to point at a different server. A wrong value here overrides the built-in default and pairing will fail with 'the target machine actively refused it'.
_PrinterName: Windows printer to spool to. Leave empty to use this PC's default printer.
